subject: Integrated Launch Activation Matrix — OKR gaps, milestone owners, and escalation routes
messages:
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Aisha Singh <aisha.singh@orchardhealth.com>, procurement@orchardhealth.com
Date: Tue, 8 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Integrated Launch Activation Matrix & OKR gaps

Team —

Attaching activation-matrix-v3.xlsx and the initial QBR asklist. This is the consolidated view I promised at leadership sync: single milestone matrix tying GTM tasks, enablement artifacts, pricing decisions, docs delivery, and support readiness to owners and OKRs. High-level asks: 

- Review assigned milestones and mark any realistic slippage by EOD Wed (9/9).
- Pricing: confirm final SKU mapping and whether we can support the promotional credits ask for Orchard by 9/10.
- Enablement: confirm which enablement assets will be ready for the field by the QBR dry run (9/14).
- Docs: doc owners to validate public vs. private docs and gap list.
- Support: confirm SLO escalation path and on-call staffing for first 3 weeks post-launch.

Notes: I flagged three OKR gaps in the spreadsheet (tabs: OKR-gap-log). Two are high-priority: 1) enablement content completeness for use-case playbooks, and 2) pricing ops automation to prevent manual adjustments during onboarding.

Aisha / Orchard procurement — sharing so you can see the milestone dates tied to procurement approvals. If procurement needs a separate timeline, flag it in reply.

I plan to consolidate responses into the QBR brief Thursday morning and run a 30-min cross-functional sync Thurs 9/10 10:00–10:30. Please accept or propose an alternate.

Thanks,
Laura
Laura Bennett
Head of GTM Programs | Redwood Inference

Attachments: activation-matrix-v3.xlsx (xls/x), QBR-asklist.xlsx (xls/x)

-----Original Message-----
From: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Aisha Singh <aisha.singh@orchardhealth.com>
Date: Wed, 9 Sep 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Integrated Launch Activation Matrix & OKR gaps

Laura — thanks for the consolidated matrix. Quick status from my side:

- GTM cadence: field enablement dry-run scheduled for 9/13 (Americas) and recordings will be uploaded by 9/14. We can make the core playbook available earlier (9/10) but playbook exercises will be incomplete until we finish the use-case walkthroughs.
- Pricing: I discussed the promotional credits ask with Finance — we can support a capped credit for Orchard but need the final list of SKUs and expected ARR uplift by EOD 9/9. I attached a short pricing-grid-v2.pdf with the current tolerances.
- Support: will confirm on-call coverage by 9/10. We have one staffing gap in week 2 that Vivek is aware of; suggestion below.

Two open items I want flagged for leadership:
1) Enablement completeness is an OKR gap unless we de-scope two lower-priority playbooks from launch. That needs a decision before 9/12.
2) If pricing automation work is delayed, onboarding will require manual adjustment and will increase time-to-value metric by ~2–3 days for affected customers — potential impact to our Q4 activation OKR.

I can join the 9/10 sync but propose we extend to 45 minutes to cover escalation routing and the Orchard procurement ask.

—Logan
Logan Wright
GTM Ops Lead | Redwood Inference

-----Original Message-----
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Aisha Singh <aisha.singh@orchardhealth.com>
Date: Thu, 9 Sep 2026 14:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Integrated Launch Activation Matrix & OKR gaps

Adding a quick ops perspective —

- Runtime/serving: model variant for Orchard is validated on staging; benchmarks show acceptable med-latency at expected throughput. Still working on a KV cache config that reduces token cost for Orchard’s typical prompt patterns. ETA: 9/12.
- Rollout/Failover: we will set a two-stage rollout (canary -> region burst) with automatic fallback to a quantized variant if latency SLO breaches. I added the rollout plan to tab 'deploy-plan' in the activation spreadsheet.
- Support escalation: recommend a primary-owner + auto-page escalation rule for P1s. Marissa, can you confirm whether CS has the rotation to cover the primary-owner window? If not, we should confirm a vendor backup.

OKR note: the pricing automation item is partially blocked by a missing API from Billing — I've opened an internal ticket and marked it in the sheet. If leadership prioritizes it, we can reassign a backend engineer to close by 9/11.

-Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Director, Orchestration | Redwood Inference

-----Original Message-----
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Aisha Singh <aisha.singh@orchardhealth.com>
Date: Fri, 10 Sep 2026 16:48:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Integrated Launch Activation Matrix & OKR gaps

Thanks team — quick update and next steps from enablement & docs: 

- Enablement: we can deliver core playbook + 2 product deep-dive recordings by 9/10 COB. Remaining use-case scripts (3 of 5) will be published as brown-bag sessions during week 1 post-launch; I've blocked delivery owners and times in the sheet.
- Docs: public quickstart and API reference will be published 9/11; internal runbook and escalations doc will be ready by 9/13. I flagged two doc items that require product sign-off (API response contract and rate-limit guidance).
- Support: Vivek confirmed an extra on-call headcount for week 2 via rotation — will be finalized tomorrow. Primary + auto-page escalation will be implemented in PagerDuty with tags for Orch accounts.

Next steps: Logan — please consolidate the affirmed dates and the final pricing SKU list into the shared Drive folder before 9/11 12:00 PM so I can finalize the QBR slide deck. Laura — can you still host the 9/10 sync? If we need 45 minutes (Logan's ask), I'm available 10:00–10:45.

Marissa Cole
Head of Enablement | Redwood Inference

Attachments referenced: pricing-grid-v2.pdf (pdf)
